title: The Standing Allowance Released Back on an Equipment Rental and Demo Security Hold
content:
A household that is square with the collective on its season passes gets some of its security hold back on that account, and a household that is behind on them gets less.

## The rule

Where the household holds a Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season, and the pass account shows nothing still to be collected on its instalments, the clean standing allowance is released back and taken off the amount kept back. The clean standing allowance is 60.00 USD.

Where the household holds a Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season and the pass account shows an instalment balance still to be collected, the declined standing allowance is released back instead. The declined standing allowance is 20.00 USD.

In any other case nothing is released back under this heading.

## The two conditions in combination

| Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season | Instalment balance on the pass account | Released back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | nothing still to be collected | 60.00 USD |
| yes | something still to be collected | 20.00 USD |
| no pass, or a pass not standing active | either way | nothing under this heading |

An instalment balance standing at nil, or standing in the household's favour, is nothing still to be collected and takes the first row.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical settlement

Take an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement on which 220.25 USD would otherwise be kept back.

- The household's pass stands active for the season and its instalments show nothing still to be collected: 60.00 USD is released back and the amount kept back is 160.25 USD.
- The household's pass stands active for the season and its instalments show 240.00 USD still to be collected: 20.00 USD is released back and the amount kept back is 200.25 USD.
- The household holds no pass standing active for the season: nothing is released back under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**Which pass is read.** A pass of the household standing active for the season the agreement belongs to, and the instalment balance read is the one that pass account shows.
